{{Quote|Uh, sir, there are clones in the main hangar.|This droid speaking to a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Umbara)|T-series tactical droid]]|<ref name="Plan of Dissent">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>}}
This '''battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] stationed above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]].

==Biography==
[[File:SepSupplyShipBridge-PoD.png|thumb|left|270px|The B1-series battle droid served under a T-series tactical droid at Umbara.]]
When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] was infiltrated by three [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] flying captured [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], this [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] was alerted that the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were actually piloted by [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] and not Umbarans and informed the [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Umbara)|T-series tactical droid]] which was in command. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] later informed the command droid that the clones were heading to the main reactor and turned on the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]]. This [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was destroyed along with the [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|supply ship]] when the clones destroyed the ship's reactor.

==Behind the scenes==
The B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].
